posts.title: Hello! I’m having a small issue with your “Moving Out Triggers Suitcase” mod. Whenever a Sim moves out together with a pet, an error occurs, and I’m no longer able to save the game.
posts.description: Oof that's no good! My apologies, I completely forgot about the fact that pets can move out too because I do it so seldom. Easily fixed by introducing a pet test, I have done so and tested that moving out with pets now is error free 😊 Please re-download Thank you for the report! 💜💙💚
